text:
maria.s: Heads-up: ACME tenant console shows a ~3h hole in usage (13:00-16:00 UTC). Customers pinging support.
kevin.ingest: on it. which pipeline? hourly or realtime?
maria.s: hourly rollups. affected across multiple customers in us-west-2 region.
ingest-bot: [alert] hourly-rollup-worker-3 restarted 2026-03-15T16:12:04 UTC due to downstream S3 error :warning:
arun-sre: paste the worker logs if you have them
kevin.ingest: logs show repeated failures listing manifest prefix, then the consumer backed off.
kevin.ingest: ```
2026-03-15T15:58:12Z ERROR worker - Failed to list objects: 403 AccessDenied for s3://redwood-ingest/manifests/us-west-2/2026/03/15/13
2026-03-15T15:58:12Z WARN  worker - Retrying in 30s
```
julia-ops: AccessDenied when listing manifests usually means ACL/replication delay or bucket policy change. Any recent infra deploys?
arun-sre: I rolled a policy tweak yesterday but only touched cross-account read for analytics, not ingest. I'll check CloudTrail.
support-bot: customer-report: ACME internal dashboard shows 0 tokens between 13:00-16:00 UTC (ticket #CS-4832)
maria.s: can we repro quickly? kevin, can you try listing the manifest prefix from the worker host?
kevin.ingest: running from worker: ```$ aws s3 ls s3://redwood-ingest/manifests/us-west-2/2026/03/15/13 --profile ingest-role
An error occurred (403) when calling the ListObjectsV2 operation: Access Denied
```
arun-sre: CloudTrail shows PutObject events from replication starting at 15:45, but S3 returned 200. However there's an S3 ObjectLock governance flag set on the manifests prefix for that bucket during the window.
kevin.ingest: weird — object lock shouldn't block listing. Could be cross-region replication lag + object metadata not yet visible to the ingest role.
julia-ops: short-term: we can run the hourly backfill job reading from parquet in the raw landing area instead of respecting the manifest. That reproduces the rows locally.
maria.s: do it and send ETA to customer. customers need visibility ASAP.
kevin.ingest: kicking off a targeted backfill for ACME for 13:00-16:00 UTC: ```scripts/replay_partition --tenant acme --start "2026-03-15T13:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-15T16:00:00Z" --source raw-landing```
kevin.ingest: job started 3123457200, estimated runtime ~40m
arun-sre: creating an incident note: root cause initial hypothesis — S3 replication + ObjectLock metadata delayed visibility to ingest-role, causing manifest lookups to fail and worker to abort backfill. Need to confirm with S3 team.
support-bot: update sent to ticket #CS-4832: "We are running a targeted backfill; ETA ~40m. Will follow up with RCA." :white_check_mark:
julia-ops: temporary mitigation: add a fallback in the aggregator to read raw landing when manifests fail for >5min and alert on manifest-list-fail rate.
kevin.ingest: backfill completed at 3123459000. I validated ACME metrics; console now shows recovered rows for the gap. Informing customer.
maria.s: thanks. please open a postmortem with timeline and suggested code-level fallback. Also add a dashboard alert for manifest list failure spikes.
arun-sre: will do. action items: (1) confirm S3 metadata propagation problem with infra (2) implement fallback path in aggregator (3) add alert + runbook for ops
maria.s: marking this thread resolved for support; follow-up PM for long-term fix.
